backup_isolation.evidence: Backups on a separate VLAN with different admin credentials; last full restore test 5 months ago.

edr_coverage.evidence: EDR on all workstations and most servers; tamper protection enabled.

email_filtering.evidence: Gateway blocks executable attachments; DMARC at enforcement; quarterly phishing simulations.

immutable_backups.evidence: No immutable or offline copy; all backups are online and reachable from the backup server.

ir_plan.evidence: Generic incident response plan exists but has no ransomware playbook and has never been exercised.

least_privilege.evidence: Many users hold local admin; domain admin membership has not been reviewed in over a year.

logging.evidence: Logs centralised for 30 days only; backup job failures are not alerted on.

mfa_coverage.evidence: MFA enforced for remote access and email; not yet on the backup console or all admin accounts.

patch_cadence.evidence: Monthly patch cycle; internet-facing systems sometimes slip to 45 days.

segmentation.evidence: Servers and users on separate VLANs, but workstations can reach each other and backup traffic shares the server VLAN.
